description:
TheBrandKit.ai turns a short questionnaire into a complete brand kit: strategy, voice, color palette, typography, a logo suite and a set of brand imagery. This connector gives your AI tool live access to those kits.

Once connected, it reads your real brand every time it creates for you: the exact hex values, the heading and body fonts, the logo variants as SVG, the imagery, the positioning and the voice guidelines with their dos and don'ts. Ask for a landing page, a deck, an email or a campaign and the output matches the brand instead of a guess at it.

It can also write for you. It reads the marketing strategies you approved in the app and writes social posts, blog posts, website copy, emails, taglines and ad ideas in your brand voice, then saves them to your Copywriting page, where you edit, tweak and reuse them. Writing charges your account's credits at the same prices as the app; reading is always free.

The connection covers every brand kit in your account and follows the same access as the app. It never deletes or rewrites a kit section, and you can disconnect it any time from Account, Connect AI.

defaultPrompt: List my brand kits and give me the color palette of the first one with exact hex values.
Read my brand voice and rewrite this email in it: [paste your draft]
Build me a one-page landing page for my brand using its exact colors, fonts and logo.
